headline: [Heartbreaking!] WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at [Age 38]
caption:
🚨 BREAKING: Heartbreaking! WWE Star Bronson Reed Dies at Age 38

WWE star Bronson Reed, whose real name was Jermaine Haley, has died at the age of 38. WWE announced on Friday that he died due to "medical complications" and did not give more details.

🔹 Reed was born in Adelaide, South Australia. He made his WWE main roster debut in 2022, won the Andre the Giant Memorial Battle Royal in 2024 and was a former NXT North American champion.
🔹 His last WWE appearance was at the Crown Jewel event in Saudi Arabia earlier this month, in a match against Oba Femi.
🔹 WWE called him "a larger-than-life figure" and "a devoted family man." He is survived by his pregnant wife, Paige, and their daughter.
